issues.title: Selected kernel and boundary recipes are referenced but not specified
issues.evidence: NUMERICAL_METHOD_SPEC names AR-002, shock-intersecting faces, Roe secant and half-Riemann; no shock sensor equation, flux-B construction, eigensystem transform or boundary root/branch equations are included. AR-002 is not a repository normative file.
issues.required_action: Consolidate the already selected equations and failure semantics into a reviewed normative annex with hashes. No new method selection or numerical campaign is requested.

issues.title: Stage/source/event and periodic scaling recipe is incomplete
issues.evidence: Exact reaction-coordinate advancement is required together with SSPRK2, but the transformation and ledger staging are absent. Exact donor/thermal rays are named without formulas; per-block periodic reference scales and event phase are not enumerated. Constants 1e-6/1e-4/3/1000 are preserved, not reselected.
issues.required_action: Supply executable algebra and exact scale/event tables from adjudicated evidence; distinguish pending verification execution from missing specification.

issues.required_action: Publish complete versioned fixtures/reference definitions and the missing VAL-022 fiche without relaxing existing thresholds. Registry assigns owners but may not manufacture missing scientific inputs.

issues.required_action: Consolidate the closed C09 map/certificate policy and exact interpolation requirements. Missing real hardware data remains an input issue, not this contract issue.
